description: Repairs r-sql-13b/join-limit-tables: the 32-table nest timed out and lost the other cases. Asks whether a nest of parenthesized INNER JOINs of 32 aliases of the one-row table One joined on ID is accepted, and at which phase, opened directly as the only statement of its probe so that nothing else is lost if the attempt times out. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
